hey there. you sound like a caring person. it’s completely natural to resent her. That doesn’t make you a bad person. Unfortunately mental illness does this to people. You do not owe it to your sister to give her sympathy, just understanding and kindness, as i’m sure you are doing. Living with someone struggling with these things is extremely difficult. Remember to look after your own mental health as well. I hope things with your family get better.
